models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.description: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct is Meta's most advanced text-only unit to date. By distilling the knowledge of massive frontier models into a high-performance 70B backbone, it achieves reasoning accuracy previously reserved for 400B+ models. Specifically optimized for complex instruction following, mathematical synthesis, and advanced software planning, it is the 'Strategic Engine' of Archer OS. Featuring a native 128K context window and the improved Llama 3.x architecture, it offers the ultimate balance between heavy-duty intelligence and localized hardware compatibility. It is the definitive choice for professional multi-agent orchestration and technical deep-dives.
